title: Beta Realm Is Online
summary: FrozenThrone now has a separate Beta realm for testing new features without risking production.
body: FrozenThrone Beta Realm is now online for testing new systems before they reach production.

title: Website V2
body: Started about a week ago and finally released version 2 of website. Stay tuned for updates

title: Working Threw it All
body:
```html
🔥 Development Update #1

FrozenThrone Development Progress

📅 July 26, 2026

Welcome to our first official FrozenThrone Development Update! We've been putting in countless hours behind the scenes preparing the server for launch. Every day we're fixing bugs, improving performance, adding new features, and making sure players have the best Wrath of the Lich King experience possible.

🐞 Bug Fixes & Beta Realm Testing

Our Beta Realm has become our primary testing ground. We've spent a tremendous amount of time identifying bugs, correcting gameplay issues, and improving overall server stability.

One of our biggest projects has been working with MMaps and NPC pathing. Better pathfinding means smoother movement, improved creature AI, and a much more polished gameplay experience throughout Azeroth.

⚔️ Solo Raid Development

Our custom Solo Raid Beta Realm continues to evolve as we test raid scaling, encounters, boss balance, and overall gameplay. Our goal is to allow players to enjoy raid content solo while still maintaining the challenge and excitement that makes Wrath of the Lich King great.

📬 Mail System Complete

The in-game mail system is now fully functional!

  • ✅ Currency rewards are delivered successfully.
  • ✅ Item rewards are delivered correctly.
  • ✅ Future Vote Shop purchases will be delivered through the mail system.

🗳️ Voting System Online

Great news! Our voting system is now fully connected and reward points are collecting correctly.

While we're finishing development of the Vote Shop, keep voting every day to build your points. Once the shop launches, you'll already have rewards waiting for you!

📢 Reminder:
You must be logged into the FrozenThrone website using your game account before voting in order to receive your points.

🌐 Website Improvements

The website continues to receive new features and improvements.

  • ✅ Account Login System
  • ✅ Voting Integration
  • ✅ News System
  • ✅ Player Rankings
  • ✅ Community Forums
  • 🚧 Vote Shop (Coming Soon)

💬 Community Forums

Our forums are now online and ready for the community!

  • 💡 Suggest new features
  • 🐞 Report bugs
  • ❓ Ask questions
  • 💬 Meet other players
  • 📢 Stay informed with future announcements

⚙️ Behind the Scenes

Every day we're continuing to improve FrozenThrone by working on:

  • 🛡️ Server optimization and performance
  • 🧭 MMaps and creature pathing
  • ⚔️ Solo Raid balancing
  • 🏰 Custom NPC development
  • 🌎 World improvements
  • 🔧 Bug fixes and quality-of-life updates
  • 💻 Website features and account integration

🚀 Looking Ahead

Development is moving forward every single day. Our goal is to create a stable, fun, and long-lasting Wrath of the Lich King server that players can enjoy for years to come.

We still have exciting features on the way, including the Vote Shop, more custom systems, additional website improvements, community events, and much more.

❤️ Thank You!

We'd like to thank everyone helping test the Beta Realm and providing feedback. Every bug report, suggestion, and vote helps make FrozenThrone stronger.

💬 Have feedback or found a bug? Leave a comment below or create a thread in the Forums. We appreciate every member of our growing community!

```
